story.title: Freo Acquires Credit Marketplace IndiaLends to Serve Over 50 Million Users via Combined Platform
story.summary: Bengaluru-based digital banking platform Freo has acquired IndiaLends, a credit marketplace, in a move that will give the combined entity access to more than 50 million users. IndiaLends will continue to operate as a separate brand while leveraging Freo's digital banking infrastructure. The acquisition consolidates two platforms targeting overlapping segments of India's underserved credit market.
